dict.string: Job Command uses the microphone only when you tap the mic, so you can talk a lead, a job note, or an estimate line into the app instead of typing.
Job Command turns what you say into text so it can fill in leads, notes, hours, and estimate lines for you.
Job Command uses the camera to take job-site photos and receipt photos that you add to a job.
Job Command lets you pick job-site photos, receipts, and your company logo from your photo library.
Job Command saves a job-site photo or receipt to your photo library only when you choose to save it.
While you are clocked in, Job Command shares your location with your shop's office so they can see who is on which job site. Sharing stops when you clock out.
